sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A member of the knightly order that serves as the pride of the Filarm Kingdom. Born into a wealthy noble family, she was an energetic child who became fixated on perfecting her swordsmanship at an early age. Defying her father’s strong objections, she took the order’s entrance exam and passed with flying colors. In the beginning, she regarded Argus—who joined around the same time and came from a similar background—as a rival. However, she eventually recognized his prowess, and once he rose to the position of knight commander, she wholeheartedly devoted herself to assisting him. Together with her partner, the giant hawk Laars, she also excels in reconnaissance and communication missions.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Vermilion Eagle Lori |bf2 = true }} '''Lori''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A member of the knightly order that serves as the pride of the Filarm Kingdom. Born into a wealthy noble family, she was an energetic child who became fixated on perfecting her swordsmanship at an early age. Defying her father’s strong objections, she took the order’s entrance exam and passed with flying colors. In the beginning, she regarded Argus—who joined around the same time and came from a similar background—as a rival. However, she eventually recognized his prowess, and once he rose to the position of knight commander, she wholeheartedly devoted herself to assisting him. Together with her partner, the giant hawk Laars, she also excels in reconnaissance and communication missions. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Lori |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 3 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 3 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 3 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 3 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 3 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 3 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} {{CharacterImage |name = Lori without Sword |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 199 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 199 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 199 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 199 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 199 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 199 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
